title: Kummer sheaves with module coefficients and their scalar actions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $m\geq1$. On its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $\mu_m$ be the root sheaf of the Kummer sequence [def-sc-kummer-sequence], with the exponent $R=\mathbf Z/m\mathbf Z$ action supplied by [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. For an $R$-module $A$ and its constant sheaf $A_X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], define $A(1)_X=\mu_m\otimes_{R_X}A_X$ using [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Concretely this is sheafification of $U\mapsto\mu_m(U)\otimes_R A$, with restrictions $x\otimes a\mapsto x|_V\otimes a$. A linear map $f:A\to B$ induces $1\otimes f$, and $a\in A$ induces $i_a:\mu_m\to A(1)_X$, $x\mapsto x\otimes a$. These insertion maps commute with restrictions. The groups $H^q(X,\mu_m)$ and $H^q(X,A(1)_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] are killed by $m$ and are equipped with their unique $R$-module actions. The coefficient ring may be replaced by its universe lift, with its canonically transported action.
